featured_reviews.name: Rishabh Bose
featured_reviews.review_text:
I live quite an active life. I love lifting weights and running and usually combine both in the same week.
Back in January ( 2026 ), I started noticing an annoying pain in my lower back. So I automatically attributed it to something I must have done in the Gym. It was bearable in the beginning but it just kept increasing on a daily basis to a point that I could not even sit for more that 10 minutes at a stretch. I stopped working out and running altogether yet the pain persisted and even increased.

I finally decided to see a Sport Physio and went to Dr. Amir  (around Feb end ). He patiently heard my entire backstory and analysed the situation and then told me exactly what the problem was.

Turns out it wasn't my Training load alone that was the culprit but my structure ( I have a natural overarch at my lower back ) along with stiff Glutes and Hamstrings which caused this issue which had become chronic by this point.

And then started my road to rehab.
He did not prescribe me a single medicine or any gear to fight my pain but showed me exercises, dynamic and passive stretches to "unstiff and untighten" my lower body and also told me to work on my Core.
We did have a handful of sessions that included Cupping, Dry Needling and some shock treatment as part of my physical therapy.

It did take quite a while for the injury to settle down and there were some ups and downs but eventually I am in a much better place right now.

If anybody is looking for a Physiotherapist in general for any kind of injury or pain relief, do yourself a favour and give a visit to Dr. Amir. He'll take care of the rest.

Since I wanted to get back to Professional Race Track riding I was very skeptical on the extensive knowledge that most doctors possess in this field (the usual doc’s don’t really understand what race track riding is about and the workouts required for someone like myself to get back in shape)
Dr.Hemant Kandoi went with a steady progression towards recovery unlike what was suggested by my surgeon. What I really appreciated was the effort made to understand what a race track rider goes through and which muscles are mostly used, needless to say the workout plan was specifically designed keeping all these parameters in mind. They also have nutritionist and psychologist on the panel is need be, Apart from that he is a great guy to talk to and I always looked forward to every weekly visit :)

More importantly, for those suffering from acute pain, mobility issues, or post-surgical weakness, traveling to a medical facility can often do more harm than good. Shivam Physiotherapy was founded on the belief that high-quality rehabilitation should not be restricted to the walls of a hospital.

We bring the clinic to you. Our Home Visit Physiotherapy Service is designed to provide hospital-grade care in the comfort, privacy, and safety of your own home. By eliminating the stress of traffic, waiting rooms, and physical exertion during travel, we allow our patients to focus entirely on what matters most: their recovery.
